svg.title: EVES: a live meeting moving through the app, from recording to a transcript in Hindi and English, to a written brief, to a prompt ready to paste.
svg.text: Records the meeting, follows Hindi and English in one sentence,
and writes the prompt your coding agent needs.

g.text: Cache layer pehle ship karte hain,
Redis rakhte hain, TTL five minutes.
Theek hai, Friday tak ho jayega.
Redis, 5-min TTL. Owners and dates from the call.
Prompt copied, ready for your coding agent
